segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-acne-prone skin mostly report the moisturizer hydrates without adding grease or shine and helps calm redness and congestion, though one reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin noticed little change in her breakouts.
segments.dry: The reviewers who describe their own skin as extra dry and sensitive report the moisturizer is hydrating and non-irritating and helps keep hormonal breakouts at bay.
segments.combination: Reports from combination-skin reviewers are mixed: several say the moisturizer hydrates without clogging pores or adding oil and calms redness and breakouts, but one reviewer with combination, blemish-prone skin says it broke her out further and felt greasy and pilled.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are mostly positive, reporting no irritation or redness and describing the moisturizer as gentle enough for regular use, though one reviewer found it too harsh for her sensitive skin and another limits use to every other day because of tingling and flushing.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who describes her skin as aging reports a strong negative reaction, with itching starting within a minute and small bumps covering her face for about a week, while her teenage daughter using the same bottle had no reaction at all.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe the moisturizer as lightweight yet genuinely hydrating, with skin feeling soft and plump rather than greasy; a few dissent, including one reviewer who found it left her skin sticky without enough hydration and another who felt slight tightness despite the moisture.
concerns.redness: Reviewers consistently report the moisturizer reduces redness and calms inflamed-looking skin, including some who say most other moisturizers make their face redder than this one does, with no reviewer in this set reporting new redness from using it.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the ceramide and tri-peptide complex with supporting or protecting the skin barrier even while the salicylic acid treats acne, with no reviewer reporting barrier damage.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report fewer or calmer breakouts within days to a few weeks of use, sometimes after an initial purging period of whiteheads and blackheads; a minority disagree, including two reviewers who say it broke them out further and one who reported no clear improvement despite continued use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin widely report the moisturizer hydrates without adding shine or grease and can even reduce midday oiliness, with several noting smaller, less congested-looking pores.

extraits.texte: I've been really impressed with the BYOMA Acne Control Moisturizer. It's lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy or sticky. I have combination skin that's prone to occasional breakouts, and this moisturizer keeps my skin hydrated while helping reduce excess oil throughout the day. What I love most is that it moisturizes without clogging my pores. My skin feels calmer, looks smoother, and new blemishes seem to heal faster with consistent use. The formula layers beautifully under sunscreen and makeup without pilling, which is a huge plus for my daily routine. I also appreciate that BYOMA focuses on supporting the skin barrier, so even with acne-fighting ingredients, my skin never felt stripped or overly dry. If you're looking for a moisturizer that balances hydration with blemish control, this one is definitely worth trying. I'd happily repurchase it and recommend it to anyone with combination or acne-prone skin.
